title: Continuity and Discontinuity of McKean-Vlasov Phase Transitions via Bifurcation Theory
summary: It is well known that the McKean-Vlasov stochastic differential equation with a symmetric double-well potential exhibits a continuous phase transition. In contrast, for an asymmetric double-well potential, the system undergoes a discontinuous phase transition, in which an invariant measure abruptly appears in the shallower well and subsequently splits into two as the temperature decreases. In this work, we systematically investigate the types of phase transitions driven by non-convex confining potentials and cooperative interactions in $\mathbb{R}^n$.
